digest.component_or_area: ticket store path resolution and configuration
propositions: relocatable ticket store is documented as a supported feature but 13 code paths bypass the resolver and hardcode repo_root/.tickets-tracker, breaking any relocated deployment

bridge_status fails with ENOENT on repo_root/.tickets-tracker/.env-id when the store is configured outside the repo root via REBAR_TRACKER_DIR or tracker.dir, despite the same store being readable through other resolver-using paths
config.tracker_dir() exists and correctly resolves the store location for in-tree and relocated deployments, but 13 sites compose store paths using string literals instead of calling the resolver
the defect was introduced by commit fe5a447061cde which created last_pass.py with hardcoded store paths despite config.tracker_dir() being documented at that commit's parent
AC1-AC16 require routing all 13 hardcoded store-path sites through config.tracker_dir() or ReconcilerSettings.tracker_dir, and enforcing the routing with a static gate that prevents new violations
